args.message: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) to the nearest cent. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Change
- Switched the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
